ritmSlot.title: Ritm
ritmSlot.body: See how fast your salary is going and what you can spend calmly today. Coming here soon.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Pay online or by card in store. In this demo, payments are simulated.
payments.simulatedNote: In-store payments can’t be paused. You get a message right away with what you have left.
payments.tapToast: You just spent {amount} at {merchant}. Safe to spend today: {safe}.

profile.title: Profile
profile.comingSoon: Your settings, Ritm included, will live here. Coming soon.

accounts.savingsEmpty: Your savings account is empty for now. If you turn on Lock in Ritm, the money you set aside lands here.

detail.notFound: We couldn’t find this transaction. It may have been cleared when the demo was reset.

ritm.notCountedTitle: Doesn’t count towards this month’s pace
ritm.counted: It comes out of your spending money until payday.
ritm.moneyIn: This is money coming in, not spending.
ritm.planned: You marked it as planned, so it doesn’t change your pace.
ritm.essential: It’s an essential cost, already taken out of your spending money.
ritm.notCounted: The money stays yours, between your own accounts or set aside.

confirm.title: Confirm payment
confirm.intro: An online shop is asking for this payment.

speedBump.title: A short pause
speedBump.body: You’re about to pay {amount} to {merchant}. Safe to spend today: {safe}. The choice is yours.

pace.aria: You've used {spent}% of your spending money and {month}% of the month has passed. {status}

line.ok: At this rate you'll reach payday comfortably.
line.watch: You're spending a little faster than the month is passing.
line.spike: Money is going faster than the days. Go easy today.

headsup.name: Heads-up
headsup.description: Tells you when you spend faster than the month passes. Nothing is blocked.

speedbump.name: Speed bump
speedbump.description: Before a big online payment, shows you the numbers and lets you confirm after 5 seconds.

lock.name: Lock
lock.description: Puts an amount aside on payday and unlocks it on the day you choose.

playground.title: Ritm · components
playground.pickDay: Pick a day of the month

s1.title: Your first salary is here
s1.l1: Ritm watches how fast your money goes since payday.
s1.l2: It tells you early if you're going too fast, not after the money is gone.
s1.l3: You choose how strict it is. You can turn it off anytime.

s2.title: The payments you have to make anyway
s2.intro: We found these in your statement. Ritm leaves them out when it watches your pace.
s2.plannedHint: Already know you'll buy something this month? Add it here and it won't trigger any heads-up.
s2.plannedInvalid: Write what you're buying and how much it costs.

s3.title: Choose how Ritm helps you
s3.lockTitle: Put some of your salary aside
s3.lockExplain: On payday we move {amount} to savings. It unlocks by itself on day {day}; if you need it sooner, you get it 24 hours after asking.
s3.lockNone: You're not putting anything aside this month. You can change this anytime.
s3.goalInvalid: Write a name and an amount for your goal.
s3.poolHint: Your salary, minus fixed payments and the amount put aside.
